docs.title: Damage Calculation
docs.text:
ExplanationTerminology DefinitionsRules of Damage Calculation

Weapon damage in Warframe is calculated through a series of hierarchical categorized stages. I've divided this process into 5 "Tiers" for clarity. Each Tier represents a "stage" of the overall damage calculation.

Damage Calculation Tiers Tier 1 - Base Damage Tier 2 - Modified Base Damage Tier 3 - Modified Non-Base Damage Tier 4 - Critical Damage Total Tier 5 - Final Damage Total

Base Damage (Tier 1)

Base Damage is the unmodified weapon damage total as it appears on the stat sheet.

Modified Base Damage (Tier 2)

"Base Damage" + "All +___% Base Damage Sources" = "Modified Base Damage" Modified Base Damage is the result of calculating the value of all damage modifications that fall into Tier 2 and then adding that value to the "Base Damage" value.

Modified Non-Base Damage (Tier 3)

"Modified Base Damage" + "All +___% Non-Base Damage Sources" = "Modified Non-Base Damage" Modified Base Damage is the result of calculating the value of all damage modifications that fall into Tier 3 and then adding that value to the "Modified Base Damage" value.

Critical Damage Multiplier

Ex. "Crit Damage: 2.3x" The Critical Damage Multiplier is the result of adding all "+___% Crit Damage" sources to calculate the final "_._x" multiplier.

Critical Damage Total (Tier 4)

"Modified Non-Base Damage" x "Total Critical Damage Multiplier" = "Critical Damage Total" Critical Damage is the result of multiplying the "Modified Non-Base Damage" by the "Critical Damage Multiplier".

Note: The value resulting from the multiplication is the final value. It is not added to the "Modified Non-Base Damage" value.

Final Damage Multiplier

Ex. "1.5x All Damage" The Final Damage Multiplier is the result of adding all "+___% Final Damage", "+___% Weapon Damage", and "._x Damage" sources together to calculate the "._x" multiplier.

Note: This is never visible on the stat sheet of a weapon because the majority of the sources for this multiplier are Warframe/Operator abilities like Rhino's Roar, or Arcane buffs.

Final Damage Total (Tier 5)

Non-Crtical Hit Final Damage "Modified Non-Base Damage" x "Final Damage Multiplier" = "Critical Damage"

Crtical Hit Final Damage "Critical Damage Total" x "Total Critical Damage Multiplier" = "Critical Damage" The Final Damage Total is the final result of multiplying either the "Modified Non-Base Damage" value or the "Critical damage Total" value by the "Final Damage Multiplier"

Note: This is the actual damage value you will see when you damage an enemy in game.

1. Damage Calculation starts at Stage 1 and advances to Stage 5.

This means all calculations begin with the weapons base unmodified damage value.

2. Damage Calculation for each stage is completed even if that stage contains no modifications.

This means the "Critical Damage Total" stage calculation is completed even if a weapon has no relavent stats that would impact the calculation.

3. Damage Calculation for each stage uses the result of the previous stage as a reference for all damage modifications within the current stage.

This means all modifications in Stage 2 will use the "Base Damage" from Stage 1 to determine their values vs modifications in Stage 3 which will use the "Modified Base Damage" from Stage 2 to determine their values.

4. The result of each stage is calculated by adding the damage modification from sources within that stage and adding that value to the result of the previous stage.

This means Stage 3's result = Stage 2's "Modified Base Damage + the total additional damage from sources within Stage 3.

4. Modifications made within a given stage are typically additive with other modifications within that same stage.

This means all "+___% Damage" sources are added together before calculating their value.

Ex: Serration(+165%) + Heavy Caliber(+165%) = +330% Base Damage.

5. Modifications made across stages or with reference to values from other stages are typically multiplicative.

This means all "+___% Damage" sources that rely on modified values from previous stages act as multipliers to those values.

Ex: "Heated Charge: +90% Heat" is a mod that falls into Stage 3 but is calculated using the "Modified Base Damage" value from Stage 2.

This is calculated as "Modified Base Damage" + ("Modified Base Damage" x 0.9) = "Modified Non-Base Damage"

For "Modified Base Damage" = 100: 100[Base Damage] + (100[Base Damage] x 0.9[Heated Charge]) = 190 "Modified Non-Base Damage"

Tier 1 - Base DamageTier 2 - Modified Base DamageTier 3 - Modified Non-Base DamageTier 4 - Critical Damage TotalTier 5 - Final Damage Total
